texts.zh:
既有派系和新兴运动都对我们在[root.GetName]建立的新殖民地产生了异常浓烈的兴趣。从我们宣布在这个适宜的[root.GetPlanetHabitat]定居的那一刻起，[root.owner.GetName]内的几乎所有政权都对此有话要说。

我们的分析人士认为没有什么重大变故正在[root.GetName]酝酿，但还是建议小心谨慎。显然，我们的各种政治实体打算就着这个新兴世界大肆宣传。
texts.en:
Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on [root.GetName]. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetName] has had something to say about it.

Our analysts don't suspect that anything truly radical is taking root on [root.GetName], but they advise some caution. It's clear our various political entities intend to campaign vigorously on this burgeoning world.

label.zh: 应当赞许这种热烈的议论！
label.en: Such vigorous debate is to be commended!

label.zh: 密切关注这些活动人士。
label.en: Keep a close watch on these activists.

label.zh: 我们不能容忍这种情况。

texts.zh:
按照指示，我们在[root.GetName]的线人一直在定期汇报殖民地政治局势的最新进展。简而言之：前景向好。

地方执法者和政治代理人设法用最少的资源把公开异见控制在了最低限度。尤其是流氓派系，没能在殖民者那里占到一丁点好处。结果是我们仍然牢牢地控制着政治生态。
texts.en:
As instructed, our informants on [root.GetName] have been delivering regular updates on the colony's developing political situation. In short: the trending outlook appears good.

Local enforcers and political agents have managed to keep outright dissent to a minimum, using only the bare minimum of resources. Rogue Factions in particular have struggled to gain any meaningful ground amongst the colonists; the result is a political environment which remains firmly within our control.

texts.zh:
我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治局势的数据，证实了我们的许多担忧。激进的边缘性运动已经成功地在殖民地的人口中获得支持。这些公民已经被社会公平和流动性的说教所动摇，并且不再认同我们社会的一些基本原则。

尽管场面不太好看，但这仍然是个好消息。我们已经积累了大量的研究，对于完善我们的[owner.GetAdj]殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们诱导了这些边缘因素，让它们在首都站稳脚跟前就自己暴露了出来。
texts.en:
The data we've been gathering about the political situation on [root.GetName] lends credence to many of our concerns. Fringe campaigns of a radical nature have managed to drum up support amongst the colony's population. These citizens have been swayed by sermons of social equity and mobility, and no longer subscribe to some of the founding principles of our society.

Despite appearances though, this still amounts to good news. We've amassed a substantial body of research, invaluable for refining our theories about [owner.GetAdj] colonial politics. Moreover: by luring out such fringe elements, we have exposed these threats long before they could ever gain a foothold on the capital.

texts.zh:
我们一直在收集有关[root.GetName]政治运动的信息，得出了一些有趣的展望。我们发现当地对新思想的包容度正在提升（超出了我们先前认定的稳定的政治思想），但没有离经叛道之举。

尽管任何偏离我们核心思想的行为都可以说是削弱了我们的权力基础，但这仍然能算是个好消息。这次试验相当于一个实际的研究样本，对于我们完善殖民政治理论非常宝贵。此外，我们已经证明，即便给予边缘因素一定的政治土壤，[owner.GetAdj]的人民也会批驳他们当中最激进的成分，并相对地向我们国家的原则靠拢。
texts.en:
The information we've been gathering about political campaigns on [root.GetName] has led to some interesting forecasts. We see a trend towards broader acceptance of new ideas - outside the bounds of what we would consider stable political thought - but no significant move towards radicalization.

Though any deviation from our core message could be said to weaken our power base, this may still amount to good news. This experiment amounts to a substantial body of research, invaluable as we refine our theories about colonial politics. Moreover: we have proven that even when fringe elements are given some ground, the [owner.GetAdj] people refute their most radical elements, and stay relatively close to our nation's principles.

label.en: These patriots are to be commended.

label.zh: 或许……也许这种想法有一定可取之处？
label.en: Or... perhaps there is some merit to this thinking?

texts.zh:
我们的政治学家一直抱着热烈的兴趣观测着[root.GetName]。然而，尽管近期掀起了激烈的竞选活动，媒体还对此大肆渲染，他们仍预计该殖民地的政治走向会是相当典型的结果。

我们的研究人员注意到，这里“没有消息”就等于是好消息：尽管我们社会中的一些边缘分子发表了声明，但目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]正在被塑造成独裁的温床。目前，民主仍然是这里的一项基础性原则。
texts.en:
Our political scientists have been observing [root.GetName] with keen interest. However, despite feverish campaigning and a lot of recent fuss in the media, they forecast a fairly typical outcome for the colony's political future.

Our researchers note that 'no news' amounts to good news here: despite what some fringe elements in our society may claim, there are as yet no signs that [root.GetName] is being molded into a hotbed of autocracy. Democracy remains a founding principle there, for now.

texts.zh: 似乎我们社会之中的一些威权主义政治组织在[root.GetName]上生根发芽。他们的许多游说活动都把目标对准了这个蓬勃发展的殖民地；此外，尽管他们明显的成功尚未引起人们的警醒：我们的政治学家却认为需要对此抱持谨慎态度。对于[root.GetName]的[root.owner.GetAdj]而言，民主并非如同我们一开始想象的那样，是那么的重要或具有吸引力。
texts.en: It seems that some of the more authoritarian political bodies in our society have gained a foothold on [root.GetName]. Their campaigns were amongst many targeting this burgeoning colony, and although their apparent success isn't cause for alarm in itself: our political scientists believe some caution may be warranted. Democracy may not be as essential or as appealing to the [root.owner.GetAdj] of [root.GetName] as we first thought.

texts.zh:
我们的政治学家对[root.GetName]进行了一段时间的监控，他们的报告证实当地存在着多种政治主张。

目前还没有迹象表明[root.GetName]会陷入无政府状态，也没有类似模式的极端治理方式。然而，这种政治冷漠行为确实为[root.owner.GetAdj]的民主带来了一些独特的挑战——以及潜在风险，如果更极端的派系在此扎根的话。
texts.en:
Our political scientists have been monitoring [root.GetName] for some time, and their reports confirm a wide range of political opinions have taken root there.

There are no signs yet that [root.GetName] will descend into anarchy, or other similarly extreme modes of governance. However, this much political jockeying does still present [root.owner.GetAdj] democracy with some unique challenges - and potential risks, if more extreme factions manage to gain a foothold there.

label.zh: 或许我们应该进行干涉。
label.en: Perhaps we ought to shake things up.

label.zh: 对于我们的治国之道，这是颇有价值的检验！
label.en: A worthy test for our way of governance!

label.zh: 我们必须保护民主制度远离这类威胁。
label.en: We must guard against threats to democracy.
